complaints.title: Where is my parcel
complaints.description: Hi, I have been waiting for my parcel since morning. Can you please check where it is and tell me when it will arrive?

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Routine domestic transit delay inquiry without tracking number
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Incomplete complaint lacking consignment number; CSR must prompt consignee for tracking ID before investigating.

complaints.title: Package not received but status says delivered
complaints.description: I got a message that my delivery was completed but I was home all day and nobody came. Where is my stuff?

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Consignee alleges fake delivery attempt / false delivery scan without receiving parcel
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Incomplete ticket missing consignment number and address details; requires callback to verify order reference.

complaints.title: Rider was very rude
complaints.description: Your delivery boy misbehaved badly when he delivered my parcel. He was shouting and showed zero respect.

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Customer reports rider spoke discourteously or showed bad attitude during delivery
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Incomplete complaint lacking rider name, date of incident, and consignment note to identify courier.

complaints.title: Refund not received
complaints.description: I returned my order last week and support promised my refund in 3 days. I still haven't received any money in my account.

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Customer inquiry regarding refund status currently within standard 3-5 day banking window
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Missing return tracking reference and bank account details needed to trace disbursement status.

complaints.title: Item arrived broken into pieces
complaints.description: I opened the box and everything inside is smashed. Why don't your couriers handle fragile items with care?

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Total breakage of fragile contents due to rough transit and improper hub handling
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Incomplete submission without parcel tracking ID, photographic evidence, or declared item value.

complaints.title: Rider asked for extra money
complaints.description: The delivery guy insisted on taking extra cash from me before handing over the parcel. This is illegal.

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Rider verbally asks for tip / round-up change on prepaid or COD parcel
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Incomplete complaint lacking order reference, exact amount extorted, and rider identifier.

complaints.title: Cannot log into my merchant account
complaints.description: My account is showing locked when I try to enter my password. I have orders to book today please fix.

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Consumer portal account locked after 5 consecutive failed login attempts
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Incomplete ticket missing registered username, merchant ID, or registered business email.

complaints.title: COD payment not credited to bank
complaints.description: Our cash on delivery remittance has not arrived in our account. When will we get paid?

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Merchant COD remittance delayed past standard Wednesday/Friday disbursement cycle (<3 days)
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Incomplete inquiry lacking merchant account ID, settlement cycle dates, or invoice numbers.

complaints.title: App keeps crashing
complaints.description: Every time I tap on tracking in your phone app, it shuts down. Please resolve this bug.

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Single user reports mobile tracking app crashes on specific OS build / device model
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Incomplete bug report missing mobile OS version, device model, and app build number.

complaints.title: You charged me twice on my card
complaints.description: I saw two deductions for the same shipping fee on my bank statement. Please refund the duplicate one.

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Customer online portal shows two identical invoices for single booking / payment authorization
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Incomplete billing complaint missing transaction reference numbers and bank statement proof.

complaints.title: Package missing from porch
complaints.description: Your courier left my parcel outside my door without calling or ringing bell. When I got home it wasn't there.

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Package left unattended without consent and subsequently lost/stolen
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Incomplete complaint missing tracking number and specific delivery date to trace delivering rider.

complaints.title: Wrong item delivered
complaints.description: I ordered clothes but received shoes in the parcel. How do I exchange this?

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Merchant packed wrong SKU / manifest matches parcel contents (merchant fulfillment error)
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Incomplete complaint lacking order reference, seller name, or waybill details.

complaints.title: Stop sending promotional messages
complaints.description: I keep getting promotional SMS on my phone from RaftarXpress every day. Remove my number from your lists.

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Customer requests opt-out from promotional broadcast SMS marketing
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Incomplete submission missing the specific phone number that requires suppression.

complaints.title: Van driver driving dangerously
complaints.description: One of your white delivery vans was speeding and swerving through our neighborhood this afternoon. Extremely dangerous.

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Citizen reports courier van driving recklessly / speeding without collision
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Incomplete report lacking vehicle registration license plate, exact street location, or exact time.

complaints.title: Tracking status not updating at all
complaints.description: The online tracker hasn't changed since yesterday. Is my shipment moving or stuck?

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Consignment tracking scan stationary for 12 hours during normal linehaul transit window
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Incomplete inquiry without tracking number; tracking status cannot be retrieved without CN.

complaints.title: Parcel seal was cut open
complaints.description: My delivery arrived today with the plastic security tape broken and resealed with regular tape.

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Parcel received with broken security tape but all items intact
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Incomplete security complaint missing consignment number and photos of the tampered packaging.

complaints.title: Weight charge too high on invoice
complaints.description: You charged me for 5kg when my package was barely 2kg. Recheck the weight and fix the bill.

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Dispute over volumetric vs dead weight calculation (< PKR 2,000 difference)
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Incomplete weight dispute missing invoice number, consignment note, and parcel physical dimensions.

complaints.title: Failed delivery attempt notification but gate was open
complaints.description: I got an automated SMS saying rider attempted delivery and house was locked. Our main gate was open and guard was sitting there all day.

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: First missed delivery attempt due to customer premises locked or phone unattended
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Incomplete complaint lacking tracking number and address details to coordinate re-attempt.

complaints.title: Return parcel not collected yet
complaints.description: I requested a return pickup two days ago. Rider has not come to collect the package.

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Failed delivery consignment held in hub awaiting second attempt or return initiation (<7 days)
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Incomplete ticket missing return booking reference and pickup address.

complaints.title: Change my warehouse pickup address
complaints.description: We moved our warehouse location to a new sector. Please update our pickup address on file.

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Merchant requests standard update to pickup warehouse address within same city
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Incomplete account request missing merchant account code and new complete address details.

complaints.title: Late delivery inquiry
complaints.description: Consignment was supposed to reach Lahore by Wednesday. Still waiting.

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Standard domestic transit delay under 24 hours without perishable contents
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Incomplete query lacking tracking number or sender/recipient contact details.

complaints.title: Damaged outer box
complaints.description: The carton delivered to our office had crushed corners and tears on the outside.

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Minor outer carton denting with internal goods completely intact
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Incomplete report without consignment number or photos showing status of inner contents.

complaints.title: Customs paper missing
complaints.description: Our shipment from Karachi to Peshawar was stopped because commercial invoice was not with the truck.

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Inter-provincial consignment missing commercial invoice / tax manifest
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Incomplete corporate freight ticket lacking vehicle number, consignment note, or bill of lading.

complaints.title: Corporate contract renewal inquiry
complaints.description: Our annual delivery agreement is nearing completion. We need to discuss rate card and terms.

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Corporate freight client requests routine annual renewal discussion with 30+ days remaining
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Incomplete inquiry without corporate account number or company contract identifier.

complaints.title: Delete my personal data
complaints.description: I want RaftarXpress to erase all my personal information, phone number, and address from your servers.

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Customer requests permanent deletion / erasure of personal data under privacy policy
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Incomplete privacy request lacking registered phone number or identity verification details.

complaints.title: Where is my parcel? Need it today
complaints.description: I have an urgent parcel coming. I need it before 5 PM today. Please trace it.

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Standard domestic transit delay under 24 hours without perishable contents
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Incomplete request without order number or tracking code; support cannot locate package.

complaints.title: Package arrived at wrong city
complaints.description: I saw on the site that my package went to Multan instead of Lahore. Please fix the route.

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Parcel misrouted to incorrect local branch within same metropolitan area
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Incomplete ticket missing consignment number to initiate immediate re-tagging and rerouting.

complaints.title: Rider demanded tip
complaints.description: Your courier would not leave our house until we gave him extra money for chai. Unacceptable.

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Rider verbally asks for tip / round-up change on prepaid or COD parcel
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Incomplete report lacking tracking number or delivery address to identify the route rider.

complaints.title: Insurance payout question
complaints.description: My claim was accepted last week. How long until the compensation is transferred?

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Customer insurance claim approved, awaiting standard banking cycle (<14 days)
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Incomplete status check missing claim file reference number.

complaints.title: Need refund for damaged package
complaints.description: I got my package yesterday and the goods were spoiled. I want a refund right away.

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Customer refund requested within 7-day policy window with photographic damage proof
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Incomplete refund claim missing order number and damage photos.

complaints.title: Parcel left with guard without telling me
complaints.description: Rider gave my parcel to the apartment building guard without calling me first.
complaints.requested_resolution: Instruct riders to call before drop-off

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Package left on porch or with building guard with verbal/implied consent
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Incomplete feedback missing tracking number and specific apartment location.

complaints.title: Webhook notifications delay
complaints.description: Our system is seeing delivery status webhooks arrive hours after deliveries occur.

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Merchant reports webhook delivery notification latency (<15 minutes average)
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Incomplete technical ticket missing merchant webhook URL, sample payload headers, and timestamps.

complaints.title: Where is my parcel? Delivery was promised yesterday

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Standard domestic transit delay under 24 hours without perishable contents
